activity_summary: The name had Sunday off for church. It sits on you like a title you did not buy. The tooth is louder than the title. You left the leaf as it was, and you stopped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the day off, and did not write on.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Not in the house. The name is his, and it waited.

facets.activity: Said the name had the day off

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It sits on me like a title I did not buy, and I am not easy.
